_comment: The dig run (#324): ore veins cut with the welder. Every number is a starting value, TODO(initiator). cut_s: seconds of holding the cut on one spot until a chunk comes off. cool_per_s: heat (0..1) lost per second when the cut is let go. chunks: chunks a full vein holds. regrow_s: seconds an empty vein takes to be full again. reach_m: how far the welder reaches (m). veins: ore item id and the spot, in metres from the dig site's centre (x east, y north).
